name: Jerry
long_description:
Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who helps you compare insurance, keep your policies organized, stay ahead of maintenance and catch recalls before they become bigger headaches. That friend is Jerry. Our vision is to be there for the whole ownership journey, from finding the right vehicle or home to helping you sell when the time is right.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

Today, we work with 100+ insurers and help customers compare, buy and bundle car, home, renters, motorcycle, boat and RV insurance. We also help with maintenance, repairs, recalls, driver safety, roadside assistance and property tax appeals. More than 5 million users have downloaded the Jerry app. We've raised $240M+ and have been profitable since 2024.

We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.
one_liner: Jerry is building the AI agent to manage all your physical assets.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: My co-founders, Lina Zhang and Musawir Shah, and I worked together at my previous startup, YourMechanic, a company that provides mobile automotive repair and maintenance services to vehicle owners at their location. Through that experience and our own personal, frustrating experiences with all car ownership hassles, we knew this was a category ripe for disruption. From determining what car to buy, financing a vehicle, finding insurance, licensing, titles, warranties, repairs, parking, and maintenance, we saw very clearly that services for car owners were lagging behind the ease and convenience offered in other industries. We wanted to remove the friction and make the transactions seamless and less expensive. The three of us set out to launch a product that would solve these hassles for car owners. We started with a car insurance compare-and-buy service that quickly gained traction. _Since then more than 5 million users have downloaded the Jerry app. We’ve also expanded our vision from car insurance shopping to the AllCar app: one app that simplifies ownership and helps people spend less time and money on their car and home. Today, in addition to our car insurance marketplace, our app helps customers with home and motorcycle insurance, Car Care, Driver Safety, roadside assistance, and property tax appeals._

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Owning a car is the second largest American household expense. And, so many components of car ownership are complicated and outdated, like buying insurance to arranging repairs. It is a big problem because owning a car should make your life easier but in many ways it makes it more complicated. Through my own experience, I learned that owning a car is not the “American dream” I hoped it would be, but rather, it’s expensive, frustrating and time consuming. We decided to build a product that takes the frustration out of car ownership – starting with shopping for and buying insurance – and makes it easy to save. Through our AI-backed insurance marketplace, drivers can sign up for Jerry in less than 5 minutes, compare personalized quotes from 100+ insurers, and purchase a policy directly in the app. This approach to revamping the insurance shopping experience saves Jerry customers on average more than $800 per year. _Through insurance we’ve started solving the small problems that contribute to the massive frustration that is car ownership in the U.S._

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is for Jerry to be the AllCar app: one app that simplifies ownership and helps people spend less time and money on their car and home. Today, Jerry helps customers compare and buy insurance, keep up with maintenance and see what a repair should cost. Our Driver Safety tools help people understand their driving and build safer habits, while their Drive Score can help them qualify for insurance discounts with participating insurers. We want to keep taking the hassle out of ownership, so people can spend less time managing their car and home and more time enjoying them. _When drivers no longer have to worry because they know Jerry is doing the work to save them time and money, we will have achieved our goal._

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Art Agrawal is co-founder and CEO of Jerry (YC S17), where he is building a service to help people spend less time and money on their vehicles and home. A serial entrepreneur focused on customer experience, he previously founded and led YourMechanic (YC W12), winner of TechCrunch Disrupt in 2012. Art attended Drexel University and started his first company at 22.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Hardware/software enthusiast, passionate about building highly usable, highly scalable products. Currently focusing on the art of running an efficient software engineering team, leading with code editor in hand.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder at Jerry.ai, currently leading legal, people ops, and recruiting. 

Prior to Jerry, I scaled operations and supply at YourMechanic (YC W12). Before that, I was a biochemist-turned-attorney specializing in intellectual property and patents at Morrison Foerster. 

Lifelong student and forever in pursuit of mastery.
